title: Commodity-bloc risk-off event basket: cross-sectional continuation drift between safe-haven and commodity currencies on the daily 16:00-NY decision clock
information_source: price-only (authorized 7-pair H1 snapshot); policy-rate series deliberately NOT used as a signal in this family
mechanism: Global risk-off shocks are expressed cross-sectionally in FX in a documented, signed pattern: the commodity currencies AUD, NZD and CAD weaken together while the safe havens JPY and CHF strengthen (Ranaldo & Soederlind 2010; Habib & Stracca 2012; Chen-Rogoff-Rossi 2010 and Cashin-Cespedes-Sahay 2004 for the commodity-currency identity of AUD/NZD/CAD; Lustig-Roussanov-Verdelhan 2011 for the cross-sectional factor structure that makes such baskets coherent objects). The mechanism under test is UNDERREACTION in this cross-section: because the forced flows are gradual - vol-targeting and risk-parity programs deleverage on trailing risk estimates over days, margin spirals propagate over days (Brunnermeier & Pedersen 2009), and carry unwinds cluster and cascade rather than complete within the shock day (Brunnermeier, Nagel & Pedersen 2009) - the cross-sectional response to a commodity-bloc risk-off day should CONTINUE to drift over the following several NY-days rather than be fully priced by the next session's close. Quantitative law, frozen: at the completion instant of each daily 16:00 America/New_York flat bar, compute the commodity-bloc strength S_t = mean( r(AUD/USD,t), r(NZD/USD,t), -r(USD/CAD,t) ) where r(.,t) is the daily log return of the pair's 16:00-NY completed closes on NY trading day t (the negated USD/CAD return expresses CAD strength in the same direction as AUD/NZD strength). Standardize z_t = (S_t - mean(S over the 60 most recent completed NY-days strictly before t)) / std(same 60 days). A risk-off event fires on day t iff z_t <= -1.0. On an event, at the open of the next session's 16:00-NY bar, enter - if that pair is flat - the 5-leg basket: SHORT AUD/USD, SHORT NZD/USD, LONG USD/CAD, SHORT USD/JPY, SHORT USD/CHF. Each leg holds exactly 5 completed NY-days and exits at the open of the 16:00-NY bar after the 5th completed NY-day (fixed horizon, no targets, no stops, no signal refresh while a position is open). Who is forced to act: risk-parity/vol-target investors and leveraged carry holders are forced to reduce pro-cyclical exposure (sell AUD/NZD/CAD, buy back JPY/CHF funding legs) as realized risk rises, with multi-day lags; why the effect persists: deleveraging cascades and hedging rebalances execute over days, and late responders observe only trailing risk, not the shock itself; when it must fail: if the cross-section fully prices the shock by the next session's close, conditional drift is zero and the anchor earns nothing but cost - the falsification is live, not decorative.
falsifiable_prediction: (i) The conditional 5-NY-day forward return of the 5-leg basket after risk-off events (z_t <= -1.0) is positive after base cost on the financing-adjusted book, with the price-only book not inverting the anchor expectancy sign; (ii) incremental alpha versus the stale-trigger benchmark (identical law, trigger read at t-10 NY-days, i.e. strictly after the 5-day drift window has closed) is strictly > 0 - fresh cross-sectional risk information, not the trading law alone, must carry the value; (iii) the sham-bloc causal control (identical basket, clocks, holding law and costs, trigger read from the unrelated majors bloc EUR/USD+GBP/USD) must NOT reproduce the edge under its preregistered rule - if it fires, the commodity-bloc information source is not the operative ingredient and the family fails regardless of the anchor's sign; (iv) all inherited Stage-A gates pass with tier-2.0 stress as a primary gate.

novelty_statement: Comparison against every row of forbidden_family_inventory.json (cumulative ancestry veto) - each shows a different information source AND a different causal control, not a clock/session/threshold/sign relabeling: (1) V1 family1 session-open (London-open) momentum continuation: information source here is a THREE-PAIR CROSS-SECTIONAL co-movement observable (bloc z-score) computed once per NY-day, not any session-open price or single-pair open-direction continuation; the causal control is a sham-bloc trigger placebo, which no V1 row had. The daily 16:00-NY clock is the cycle's structural choice, not a re-clock: no forbidden row's mechanism is expressed at this clock, and this is not the same mechanism relabeled - the observable, the direction source and the holding law (fixed 5-day horizon) are all new. (2) V1 family2 late-NY standardized-extension fade: no within-day extension measurable anywhere, no fade - this family predicts multi-day CONTINUATION (drift) after an event, the opposite trade construction (and, per the blanket clause, deliberately NOT a sign inversion of that row: different observable, different clock, different holding horizon, different information source). (3) V2 family1 Tokyo-range compression -> London-morning expansion: no session range, no compression/expansion state transition, no breach precondition; the trigger is a standardized cross-sectional return event, not a session-structure geometry. (4) V2 family2 London-AM range break with retest-hold: no range break and no retest-hold confirmation anywhere in state, trigger, entry or exit. (5) V3 family1 (FXFV3-A5-P1, policy-divergence-gated daily trend): no policy input of any kind in this family and no price-trend term anywhere - direction is set by a frozen cross-sectional event map, not by trend-gating; the trading laws are structurally different (fixed-horizon event basket vs state-gated trend). (6) V3 family2 (FXFV3-A6-P1, realized-vol regime-gated policy-rate-differential carry, DATA_AUTHORITY_INVALIDATED): no policy-rate differential anywhere in trigger or direction (this is not the Section 1.1 carry front door and does not invoke it), no realized-vol state gate (the z-score is a signed one-day event trigger, not a vol-state holding gate), no differential-direction holding law, no financing-dependent direction. A7-N's rho check should also compare against BOTH V3 family2 variants per the audit note; nothing in this packet reuses the differential/vol-gate ingredients those books turn on. Blanket clauses: no sign inversion of any rejected family; no cost assumptions below the frozen 1.5 bps x {1.0,1.5,2.0} authority; no pair cherry-picking (the 5-leg set and the EUR/GBP exclusion are fixed ex ante from the cited literature, before any outcome exists); no result-aware reuse of any earlier packet - fresh blind packet, new hypothesis_id, independent design.

universe.subset_justification: Causal, decided ex ante, never cherry-picked: the trigger bloc is exactly the documented commodity-currency trio (Chen-Rogoff-Rossi 2010 QJE; Cashin-Cespedes-Sahay 2004 JDevEcon) and the response legs are exactly the documented safe havens plus their commodity counterparties (Ranaldo-Soederlind 2010; Habib-Stracca 2012). EUR/USD and GBP/USD are held OUT of the anchor because neither is a documented safe haven nor a commodity currency; they are reserved as the sham trigger bloc of the causal control, which is why their exclusion is a design integrity requirement, not a result-aware subset. USD sign conventions are frozen explicitly: AUD/NZD strength = +r(AUD/USD), +r(NZD/USD); CAD strength = -r(USD/CAD); JPY/CHF strength = -r(USD/JPY), -r(USD/CHF).

warmup: 60 completed valid NY-days of daily 16:00-NY closes for the three trigger pairs (approx 85 calendar days; a NY-day is valid only if all of that day's completed H1 bars exist - fail-closed). First possible decisions therefore inside early May 2020, within fold F1. No macro warmup is needed (price-only family).
holding_period: Exactly 5 completed NY-days per leg (fixed horizon; the drift window under test). No profit target, no stop, no time extension, no signal refresh while a leg is open.
entry_rules: On day t with z_t <= -1.0: if a given leg is flat, enter its frozen direction at the open of the next session's 16:00-NY bar (one-event lag). If a leg is already in a position, the new event is ignored for that leg (no refresh, no extension). Governor: max 1 position per pair, max 1 entry per pair per NY-day; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred.
exit_rules: Exit at the open of the 16:00-NY bar after the 5th completed NY-day following entry. Missing entry/exit bar => signal voided or earliest-scheduled exit, never fill-forward. Force-flat: any open leg exits at the open of the 16:00-NY bar of the last decision day before a fold boundary; no position crosses a fold boundary.
fill_convention: Next-session fill at the open of the first 16:00-NY bar of the next NY trading session strictly after the decision instant - at least one full session after the decision (one-event lag), and at most 4 calendar days later over holiday weekends (e.g. Thursday decision -> Monday fill across Good Friday), which respects the 4-day next-session validator constraint; a fill gap that would exceed 4 days fails closed to NO_TRADE. Never same-bar fills, never fill-forward.

anchor.spec: Exactly the frozen mechanism law: S_t = mean of the three signed daily bloc returns; z_t on trailing 60 completed NY-days; event iff z_t <= -1.0; 5-leg basket entries at next-session 16:00-NY bar open when flat; 5-NY-day fixed holding; force-flat folds; dual book (price-only and financing-adjusted) per frozen kernel.

single_frozen_parameter_set.event_threshold: -1.0 (one trailing sigma below the trailing mean; single frozen value, no tuning)

neighbour.one_presumption_away: Replaces only the central-tendency presumption of the bloc measurement (MEAN of the three signed returns) with the MEDIAN of the same three signed returns - a robust-estimator swap holding the same presumption 'the commodity bloc is in a sharp common decline'. If the mechanism is real, the neighbour moves TOGETHER with the anchor (same verdict sign, similar fold pattern); divergence means the trigger sits on a knife edge (e.g. oil-idiosyncratic CAD days contaminating the mean) and the family is not promotable.
neighbour.spec: Byte-identical to anchor in every frozen constant EXCEPT S_t^neigh = median( r(AUD/USD,t), r(NZD/USD,t), -r(USD/CAD,t) ); same 60-day standardization, same -1.0 threshold, same legs, same holding, same clocks, same costs.

control.role: Placebo-style causal control: destroys exactly the operative ingredient - the COMMODITY-BLOC information source of the trigger - while holding the basket map, clocks, holding law, costs, governor and dual book identical. The trigger is read from the sham majors bloc: z^sham_t = standardize( mean( r(EUR/USD,t), r(GBP/USD,t) ) ) over its own trailing 60 completed NY-days; event iff z^sham_t <= -1.0; otherwise the book is byte-identical to the anchor.
control.disclosed_leakage: EUR and GBP are part of the broad global risk complex and also weaken (with lower beta) in global risk-off, so the sham trigger is correlated with the true trigger's firing days; the control is NOT a claim of independence from global risk - it is the preregistered test of whether COMMODITY-BLOC-SPECIFIC information, rather than generic majors weakness, is the operative ingredient. Under the preregistered family claim, a firing control is a falsification, not a rescue.
control.runs_to_completion: Yes: price-only triggers on pairs in the authorized snapshot; every decision has an observable; the book executes under evidenced semantics with the same fail-closed rules as the anchor (no refused-by-construction arm - the V3R lesson is respected: a control that cannot execute has null evidentiary value).
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: The control REPRODUCES (and the family FAILS its control gate regardless of the anchor's sign) if control financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10, OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy. Positive raw control PnL never overrides a firing control.

incremental_test.benchmark_definition: Per the frozen benchmark_treatment convention (macro conditioning removed, everything else identical): the anchor law with the trigger read STALE - S evaluated on NY-day t-10 instead of t (staleness 10 NY-days strictly exceeds the 5-NY-day drift window, so the benchmark's entries arrive after the window under test has closed). Identical legs, clocks, holding, fills, costs, folds.
incremental_test.gate: overall incremental alpha > 0: anchor financing-adjusted expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted expectancy, evaluated under the same gates as the anchor. Positive raw anchor PnL never overrides a failed incremental alpha. The benchmark is an auxiliary treatment inside the anchor cell, not a fourth scored arm.

costs.application: F1-FIXED: tier multipliers are applied to BOOKED stress PnL through the inherited P1 accounting kernel; base / tier-1.5 / tier-2.0 rows must be pairwise distinct when trades are non-empty. Tier 2.0 is a PRIMARY Stage-A gate, not an appendix.
costs.delay_stress: Frozen one-session delay (entry and exit each shifted one additional 16:00-NY bar) carried as a SEPARATE stress component, never blended into the cost tiers.
costs.break_even_reporting: break_even_bps_per_fill = mean gross per-trade return (bps of the 10000 USD unit, both books) / 2, reported full-sample and per fold. Frozen interpretation: a cell whose break-even bps sits below the tier bps cannot pass Stage-A for cost reasons rather than absence of gross edge; diagnostic, never a fee rescue.

turnover_and_sample_floor.fold_scheme: 3 chronological folds over the decision span (F1 2020-03-01..2022-05-01, F2 2022-05-01..2024-07-01, F3 2024-07-01..2026-09-02; UTC dates; warmup excluded). Purge 14 calendar days either side of internal boundaries; trades whose entry OR exit instant falls inside a purge window are excluded from fold statistics and counted in purge_excluded. Stage-A requires >= 2/3 populated folds positive; a fold is populated iff >= 30 trades.
turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_per_pair_estimate: ~1,450 NY-day decisions per leg after warmup (~7,250 aggregate) - one evaluation per pair per NY-day; >= 40 decisions per arm satisfied by two orders of magnitude.
turnover_and_sample_floor.trades_estimate: Risk-off events (z <= -1 on a fat-tailed daily bloc mean) occur on roughly 10-16% of NY-days, clustered; with flat-only entries and 5-day holds this yields an estimated 35-70 entries per leg over the ~6.3y post-warmup span, i.e. ~175-350 trades across 5 legs full-sample. Preregistered band 4-11 round trips per leg-year.

sample_floors.populated_rule: fold populated iff >= 30 trades; a cell below floors is INDETERMINATE, not negative evidence

turnover_and_sample_floor.cost_thesis: The 5-day horizon is the cost thesis: conditional drift must exceed 3 bps round trip at base tier (6 bps at tier 2.0). Break-even bps per cell will attribute any reject to cost vs absence of gross edge.

drop_one_design.procedure: Recompute the full anchor schedule (and neighbour/control/bench identically) 6 times: 5 leg-drops (each excluding exactly one of AUD/USD, NZD/USD, USD/CAD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF - the basket renormalizes to the remaining 4 legs with the frozen map unchanged) + the inherited best-fold drop. 6 scenarios total.
drop_one_design.gate: Anchor financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.00 in at least 5 of 6 scenarios (proportional tightening of the inherited M1-DEV 6/8 rule to the 6-scenario design).
drop_one_design.non_vacuity: Each leg-drop changes the basket composition and the trigger-response pair set (dropping a trigger leg also changes S_t), so every scenario's schedule differs from the full book by construction; asserted at implementation as a test.
drop_one_design.interpretation: Failure means the edge is a single-leg artifact (e.g. one currency's episode), not a cross-sectional bloc mechanism. Note the disclosed design consequence: dropping EUR/USD or GBP/USD is not a scenario (they are not traded legs) - their role is the control's sham bloc, which is a separate falsification.

governor.enforcement: Deterministic and PIT-safe; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred.

dual_book_and_financing.mandate: Every scored cell books BOTH price_only_pnl_usd and financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate immutable digest-covered columns, all arms (inherited kernel).
dual_book_and_financing.financing_formula_frozen_verbatim: financing_adjusted_pnl = price_only_pnl + sign * notional_usd * (r_base - r_quote) * holding_days/365, accrued per calendar day at the day-start as-of policy-rate differential from the evidenced BIS WS_CBPOL vintages (rows eligible only when available_time_utc <= the accrual instant; never eligible on their own effective date).
dual_book_and_financing.disclosed_approximation: Policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS-implied rollover; disclosed ex ante per inherited convention (HISTORICAL_ROLLOVER_FINANCING UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED).
dual_book_and_financing.financing_gate: The financing term must not manufacture the edge: the price-only book must not invert the sign of the anchor's expectancy (Stage-A gate). This family is price-only in its signal, so a sign inversion would indicate the financing approximation is doing the work.

failure_interpretation: Negative anchor expectancy after base cost: commodity-bloc risk-off events carry no after-cost cross-sectional continuation edge at the frozen cost authority on this snapshot - a complete, publishable reject with break-even bps attributing cost vs gross absence; no sign inversion, no threshold/lookback rescue, no leg subset, no lower cost, no re-clocking. Anchor positive but the sham-bloc control fires under its preregistered rule: the commodity-bloc information source is not operative (generic majors weakness or the basket law alone explains it) and the family fails its control gate regardless of anchor sign. Anchor positive but incremental alpha <= 0 vs the stale-trigger benchmark: fresh cross-sectional risk information adds nothing beyond the trading law; the underreaction claim is falsified and the family is not promotable. Anchor positive on financing-adjusted but price-only inverts the expectancy sign: the edge is manufactured by the financing approximation; fails the dual-book gate. Neighbour diverges from anchor: the bloc measurement is knife-edge fragile (likely CAD idiosyncrasy); not promotable. Drop-one or concentration failure: single-leg artifact; reject. Realized turnover outside the preregistered band on the real snapshot: INELIGIBLE per the frequency contract. Any gate failure is terminal for the family as specified - thresholds, legs, horizons and clocks are never re-tuned post-observation.

margin_to_fail_expectations.pf_ge_110: Expected 1.00-1.25 if real; this is historically the thinnest gate type (the V3 arc died on one thin gate). Knife-edge risk HIGH.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_of_3: F1 (2020-03..2022-05) contains the COVID cluster - event concentration there could make F1 dominate or dominate negatively; expected 2/3 positive if real. margin_to_fail_expectations.mdd_within_frozen_ceiling: Clustered simultaneous 5-leg entries (2020-03-type weeks) are the MDD driver; expected 800-2200 USD vs the frozen 2500 ceiling -> margin 300-1700. MODERATE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_tier_2_0_primary: Gross per-trade must clear 6 bps RT at tier 2.0; expected gross 20-80 bps IF the effect exists -> headroom 3-13x on cost, but the tier-2.0 PF is expected 0.95-1.15. Knife-edge risk HIGH; this is the gate type that killed the V3 arc.

Expected max-leg share of gross positive PnL 25-40% - knife-edge MODERATE (JPY/CHF legs are correlated and could jointly dominate).
margin_to_fail_expectations.usd_drift_gate: The basket is near USD-neutral by construction (net +1 of 5 units long USD); expected |corr(daily PnL, USD-wide move)| 0.05-0.20 vs the 0.3 ceiling -> margin 0.10-0.25. MODERATE-LOW.
margin_to_fail_expectations.incremental_alpha_gt_0: Staleness (10 NY-days) strictly exceeds the 5-day drift window, so the benchmark books post-window returns; expected incremental margin = a large fraction of anchor expectancy IF the effect is fresh-information-driven. Residual risk: if risk-off episodes persist >10 days, the stale trigger fires on overlapping states and erodes the margin. Expected margin THIN-POSITIVE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_non_reproduction: Expected control expectancy in [-inf, +0.4x anchor] given the disclosed EUR/GBP risk-factor leakage; the 0.5x tripwire could genuinely fire. This control is a real falsification risk by design. Expected outcome: does not fire IF the bloc-specific claim is right; MODERATE risk.
margin_to_fail_expectations.sample_floor: Decisions margin ~150x floor (trivial); trades margin est. 1.25-2.5x the 140 floor -> MODERATE; below floor => INDETERMINATE (not negative).
margin_to_fail_expectations.overall_prior: Conditional on the effect existing, the most likely failing gates are PF>=1.10 and tier-2.0 stress (knife-edge class); conditional on it not existing, expectancy fails outright. No gate is expected to be failed by cost arithmetic if the gross effect exists.

no_parameter_grid_note: Exactly one frozen value per constant per arm (3 trigger pairs with frozen signs, 60-day window, -1.0 threshold, 5 legs with frozen directions, 5-day holding, 10-day benchmark staleness, fixed derangement-free sham bloc). No grids, menus or tuning anywhere; the neighbour is a distinct single frozen spec, not a second point on the anchor's knob.
lane_diversity_note: This family is price-only.
